title: Past simple and present perfect
summary: Past simple или present perfect: завершённое время и период «до сих пор», связь с настоящим, новости, just/already/yet, since/for, first time, has been и has gone, британский и американский варианты.
ru:
## Главный критерий: «закрытое» или «открытое» время
Если время действия **закончилось и названо** (yesterday, in 2019, last week, two years ago, when I was a student), нужен **past simple**. Если мы говорим о периоде, который **продолжается до настоящего** (today, this week, so far, recently, ever, never, since, for), нужен **present perfect**.
> I spoke to the director yesterday. — Я разговаривал с директором вчера.
> I've spoken to the director twice this week. — Я разговаривал с директором дважды на этой неделе. (неделя ещё не кончилась)
Считается не календарь, а то, как говорящий видит период: **I haven't had a holiday this year** (год ещё идёт) — но **I didn't have a holiday last year**.

## Связь с настоящим
Present perfect нужен, когда прошлое **важно сейчас**: результат виден, ситуация длится или новость свежая.
> The Senate has approved the budget. — Сенат утвердил бюджет. (новость, итог актуален)
> I've cut my finger. — Я порезал палец. (видна рана, нужен пластырь)
Стоит перейти к деталям — когда, где, как — и мы возвращаемся в past simple:
> The Senate has approved the budget. It voted on Tuesday night by 52 to 48. — Сенат утвердил бюджет. Голосование прошло во вторник вечером, 52 голоса против 48.

## Слова, которые «решают»
- С **past simple**: yesterday, last year, in 2018, ago, then, when + вопрос в прошлом (**When did you...?**).
- С **present perfect**: just, already, yet, so far, ever, never, recently, lately, for, since, how long, this morning/week (если период ещё не закончился).
- Present perfect **нельзя** с точным прошедшим временем: ~~I have seen him yesterday.~~ → I **saw** him yesterday. ~~When have you arrived?~~ → When **did** you arrive?

## For и since, first time
> I've known Ana since 2010 / for fifteen years. — Я знаю Ану с 2010 года / пятнадцать лет.
> It's the first time I've tasted fermented tea. — Я пробую ферментированный чай в первый раз.
После **It's the first/second/best... time** и после превосходной степени (**the best film I've ever seen**) используется present perfect. Сравните прошлое: **It was the first time I had...**.

## Has been и has gone
> Where's Max? — He's gone to the dentist. — Он пошёл к стоматологу (и ещё там / в пути).
> Max has been to the dentist. — Макс бывал у стоматолога / уже вернулся.

## Британский и американский варианты
В британском английском с **just, already, yet** обычно present perfect: **I've already eaten. Have you finished yet?** В американском допустим и past simple: **I already ate. Did you finish yet?** Для экзаменов и письма безопаснее британская норма, но американский вариант не ошибка.

## Типичные ошибки
- ~~I have lost my keys yesterday.~~ → I **lost** my keys yesterday.
- ~~She lives here since 2018.~~ → She **has lived** (or **has been living**) here since 2018.
- ~~I am here for two days.~~ → I **have been** here for two days.
- ~~How long do you know him?~~ → How long **have you known** him?
en:
## The key idea: 'closed' or 'open' time
If the time of the action is **finished and stated** (yesterday, in 2019, last week, two years ago, when I was a student), use **past simple**. If we talk about a period that **continues up to now** (today, this week, so far, recently, ever, never, since, for), use **present perfect**.
> I spoke to the director yesterday.
> I've spoken to the director twice this week. (the week is not over)
What matters is not the calendar but how the speaker sees the period: **I haven't had a holiday this year** (the year is still going) - but **I didn't have a holiday last year**.

## Connection with the present
We use present perfect when the past **matters now**: the result is visible, the situation continues, or the news is fresh.
> The Senate has approved the budget. (news; the result is relevant)
> I've cut my finger. (there is a wound, I need a plaster)
Once we move on to details - when, where, how - we go back to past simple:
> The Senate has approved the budget. It voted on Tuesday night by 52 to 48.

## Words that decide
- With **past simple**: yesterday, last year, in 2018, ago, then, **When did you...?**
- With **present perfect**: just, already, yet, so far, ever, never, recently, lately, for, since, how long, this morning/week (if the period is not over).
- Present perfect is **not** used with a finished point in time: ~~I have seen him yesterday.~~ → I **saw** him yesterday. ~~When have you arrived?~~ → When **did** you arrive?

## For and since, first time
> I've known Ana since 2010 / for fifteen years.
> It's the first time I've tasted fermented tea.
After **It's the first/second/best... time** and after superlatives (**the best film I've ever seen**) we use present perfect. The past version is **It was the first time I had...**.

## Has been and has gone
> Where's Max? - He's gone to the dentist. (he is there or on his way)
> Max has been to the dentist. (he went and came back; or he has that experience)

## British and American usage
In British English, **just, already, yet** normally go with present perfect: **I've already eaten. Have you finished yet?** In American English past simple is also fine: **I already ate. Did you finish yet?** For exams and formal writing the British pattern is safer, but the American one is not a mistake.

## Common mistakes
- ~~I have lost my keys yesterday.~~ → I **lost** my keys yesterday.
- ~~She lives here since 2018.~~ → She **has lived** (or **has been living**) here since 2018.
- ~~I am here for two days.~~ → I **have been** here for two days.
- ~~How long do you know him?~~ → How long **have you known** him?
structure:
## Формы
| | Утверждение | Отрицание | Вопрос |
|---|---|---|---|
| Past simple | He called. | He didn't call. | Did he call? |
| Present perfect | He has called. | He hasn't called. | Has he called? |

## Что выбрать
| Время | Форма | Пример |
|---|---|---|
| Закончилось, названо | past simple | I met her in 2017. |
| Период до сих пор | present perfect | I've met her twice this month. |
| Свежая новость | present perfect → детали в past simple | He's resigned. He announced it at noon. |
| Опыт | present perfect | I've never flown a plane. |
| Длится до сих пор | present perfect + for/since | I've worked here for years. |
| Вопрос «когда» | past simple | When did it happen? |

## Особые модели
> It's the first time + subject + **have/has + V3** → It's the first time I've skied.
> the best / worst / most ... + noun + **I've ever + V3** → the worst meal I've ever had
> **gone** (ушёл и отсутствует) ≠ **been** (был и вернулся)

## BrE и AmE
| Британский | Американский |
|---|---|
| I've just seen her. | I just saw her. |
| Have you finished yet? | Did you finish yet? |
| She's already left. | She already left. |

exercises.title: Past simple или present perfect?
exercises.instruction: Поставьте глагол в скобках в past simple или present perfect.
exercises.example: I (lose) my passport — can you help me look? → I've lost my passport.

items.text: I {{have lost|'ve lost}} my passport - can you help me look for it?
Einstein {{developed}} the theory of relativity in the early twentieth century.
We {{haven't seen|have not seen}} each other since the conference.
She {{has been|'s been}} to Japan three times, so she knows the culture well.
This is the best coffee I {{have ever had|'ve ever had|have ever drunk|'ve ever drunk}}.
It's the third time this week that the train {{has been|'s been}} late.
I {{have lived|'ve lived|have been living|'ve been living}} in this town since 2015, and I love it.
Last summer we {{rented}} a cottage in Cornwall.

exercises.title: Just, yet, so far...
exercises.instruction: Вставьте пропущенное слово или поставьте глагол в скобках в нужную форму (past simple или present perfect).

items.text: The delegates {{have just arrived|'ve just arrived}}, so we can start in ten minutes.
She {{has written|'s written}} three novels so far.
He {{wrote}} his first novel when he was nineteen.
How many countries {{have you visited}} so far?
Where {{did you buy|did you get}} those boots? I'd like a pair.
Mia {{has never been|'s never been}} abroad, so she's excited about the trip.
The museum {{closed}} in 2019 and hasn't reopened since.

exercises.title: Выберите правильную форму
exercises.instruction: Выберите вариант, подходящий по смыслу и по времени.

items.q: I ___ the new Nolan film last night.
It's the first time I ___ a drone.
items.why: После **It's the first time** — present perfect.

items.q: Where's Tara? — She ___ to the bank; she'll be back soon.
items.why: **Has gone** — сейчас её нет, **has been** значило бы, что она уже вернулась.
Вы всё ещё здесь работаете: период до сих пор — **have you worked**.

items.q: It's only 11 a.m., and I ___ three cups of coffee already.

items.why: Since 2018 → ситуация длится до сих пор: **present perfect**.

options: Scientists announced a major discovery yesterday.
Scientists have announced a major discovery yesterday.
It's ten years since I last saw her.
It's ten years since I have last seen her.
items.why: После **since** (союз) событие в past simple: since I last saw her.

options: He has been to Kenya twice, but never to Tanzania.
He has gone to Kenya twice, but never to Tanzania.
items.why: Опыт поездок — **has been to**; has gone значит «сейчас там».

exercises.title: Составьте предложения
exercises.instruction: Составьте предложение из слов, выбрав past simple или present perfect. Добавьте нужные слова.

answers: They sold the house in 2020.

items.prompt: (we / not / hear / from Carla / for months)
answers: We haven't heard from Carla for months.
We have not heard from Carla for months.
Have you ever climbed a mountain?
He has just received a promotion.
He's just received a promotion.
When did the film begin?

items.prompt: (it / be / the first time / she / fly)
answers: It's the first time she has flown.
It is the first time she has flown.
It's the first time she's flown.
It is the first time she's flown.

exercises.title: Перепишите предложение
exercises.instruction: Перепишите предложение так, чтобы смысл остался прежним. Используйте слова в скобках или present perfect.

items.prompt: The last time I played tennis was in June. → I (not / play) tennis ... June.
answers: I haven't played tennis since June.
I have not played tennis since June.

items.prompt: It's a long time since we met. → We (not / meet) ... a long time.
answers: We haven't met for a long time.
We have not met for a long time.

items.prompt: She started working here in 2016, and she still works here. → She ... here since 2016.
answers: She has worked here since 2016.
She's worked here since 2016.
She has been working here since 2016.
She's been working here since 2016.

items.prompt: This is my first visit to Seoul. → I (never / be) ... to Seoul before.
answers: I have never been to Seoul before.
I've never been to Seoul before.

items.prompt: It's two years since I changed jobs. → I (change) jobs ... two years ago.
answers: I changed jobs two years ago.

exercises.title: Напишите о себе
exercises.instruction: Ответьте на вопросы полными предложениями на английском, выбирая past simple или present perfect.

items.prompt: What is the most interesting place you have ever visited? When did you go there?
items.sample: The most interesting place I've ever visited is Istanbul. I went there three years ago.

items.prompt: What have you done today so far?
items.sample: I've had breakfast, answered some emails and done my English homework.

items.prompt: How long have you known your best friend? How did you meet?
items.sample: I've known her for ten years. We met at university in 2015.

items.prompt: Describe something you have never done but would like to do.
items.sample: I've never travelled alone, but I'd really like to try it next year.

items.prompt: What was the last film you saw? Is it the best film you have ever seen?
items.sample: I saw a documentary about the oceans last week. It's one of the best films I've ever seen.
